guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low, on the next rising clock edge in_process is cleared to 0.
When rst_ni is high, on the rising clock edge, if hash_process or reg_hash_stop is high, in_process is set to 1.
When rst_ni is high, on the rising clock edge, if reg_hash_done is high and neither hash_process nor reg_hash_stop is high, in_process is cleared to 0.
When rst_ni is high and none of hash_process, reg_hash_stop, reg_hash_done are true, in_process retains its previous value.

assumptions.claim: reg_hash_done must not be asserted at the same time as hash_process or reg_hash_stop; the set condition dominates and will prevent in_process from being cleared.
assumptions.risk: in_process stays high, potentially stalling downstream logic that waits for process completion.

uncertain_points.claim: Coincident assertion of reg_hash_done with hash_process or reg_hash_stop can cause a missed clear of in_process, leaving the process indicator stuck high.
uncertain_points.cond: reg_hash_done asserted while hash_process or reg_hash_stop is also asserted
uncertain_points.risk: If in_process gates further key/hash operations, the HMAC may permanently stall until a subsequent done without a concurrent start/stop.
